title: slovakian oranges bake
description: light, airy, and quick-fix slovakian dessert featuring fresh oranges and beurre-monte, perfect for low-carb diets

ingredients.name: beurre-monte (whipped heavy cream and unsalted butter)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine eggs, granulated sweetener, and melted unsalted butter. Blend until smooth.
Add the orange zest, juice, and vanilla extract to the blender. Blend until combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
While the bake is in the oven, prepare the beurre-monte by whipping the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the beurre-monte into the melted unsalted butter until combined.
Remove the bake from the oven and top with the beurre-monte mixture.
Return the bake to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the beurre-monte is lightly golden brown.
Remove the bake from the oven and sprinkle with flaked unsweetened coconut.
